svg.title: The graph behind it: the sherd and the place name

g.text: the chain reaches below the findspot — and ends at a number only the authority keeps
Denkmaldaten / BLDAM 2021 · the coordinates were requested from the BLDAM and adopted
The monument number and the activity number GV
but only inside the heritage authority. The
excavation happened because the B 1n bypass was
here the place name carries a whole culture — and has no record of its own
von Richthofen 1930, Karte 2 · the municipality was looked up in digital map services and its approximate centre read off
"Late Neolithic culture marking the final phase of the Lengyel
culture in eastern Central Europe; term introduced in 1906 by
Hans Seger after the Lower Silesian findspot of Jordansmühl"
So the place name survives in the GND only inside the definition of
a subject term — as running text, not as a link, and without the
place itself having a record at all.
